d: Violence erupts as Gen Z protests in Germany. Tens of thousands of Germans took to the streets across 34 cities to protest against the cost-of-living crisis and mandatory military service. Firstpost looks at how the protests turned violent, with clashes in Hamburg, and widespread looting in Frankfurt. Hem Kaur Saroya also examines the group called Gen Z Regelt, which means Gen Z Takes Charge, which is organising the demonstrations. HKS also sees how the protests in Germany compare to the mobilisation taking place across the rest of Europe.
